PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Angus's clue ("He was the only person beside a basket."). So Angus (A) must be at row 4, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Angus crossed out, only one square is left for Desmond that fits his clue ("He was in the Tool Shed, but not beside the sack."). So Desmond (D) must be at row 7, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Conrad: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 9, column 1. So nobody else can stand at row 9, column 1, or Conrad would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Look at Elsa: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 5, column 2. So nobody else can stand at row 5, column 2, or Elsa would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Look at Howard: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 1, column 9. So nobody else can stand at row 1, column 9, or Howard would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. So Conrad (C) must be at row 8, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Suppose Elsa were at row 5, column 2: then Bonnie would have nowhere left to go. So Elsa can't be there. So Elsa (E) must be at row 6, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: Who can be the person beside a pig in Bonnie's area? Only Virgil, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Bonnie's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a pig."). That rules out Virgil's other squares. Gemma's own clue ("She was exactly one row north of Fergus.") rules out more squares. Gemma is now the only person who can still go in column 8. So Gemma (G) must be at row 1, column 8. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Howard that fits his clue ("He was in the Farmhouse Kitchen, but not beside a table."). So Howard (H) must be at row 3, column 9. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Fergus that fits his clue ("He was exactly two columns east of Angus."). So Fergus (F) must be at row 2, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_11_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Virgil. So Virgil (the victim) must be at row 5, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_12_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Bonnie that fits her clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a pig."). So Bonnie (B) must be at row 9, column 6. Cross out her row and column. Bonnie is the only person in the Pigsty with Virgil, so Bonnie is the murderer!
